result.summary: The page looks mostly functional with one notable visual issue found.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated with no ellipsis, cutting off the full name abruptly. This is distinct from the intentional partial-card reveal at the right edge — the text label below the card is fully within the viewport but still clipped without proper truncation styling.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and a defined max-width to restaurant name labels to ensure graceful truncation rather than a hard cut-off.
